name: Sildenafil
route_note: Oral tablet taken about an hour before sexual activity for ED; three times daily (oral or IV) for PAH

discovery.by: Pfizer chemists at Sandwich, Kent (including Andrew Bell, David Brown and Nicholas Terrett)
discovery.note: Developed as a treatment for angina; penile erections noted in early trials redirected development.

rx_status: prescription; pharmacy (OTC) in the UK since 2018
tagline: PDE5 inhibitor for erectile dysfunction and pulmonary arterial hypertension
summary: Sildenafil is a selective inhibitor of phosphodiesterase type 5 that enhances nitric oxide–cGMP signalling. Originally studied for angina, it became the first oral treatment for erectile dysfunction in 1998 and is also used for pulmonary arterial hypertension.
mechanism: Sexual stimulation releases nitric oxide in the corpus cavernosum, which activates guanylate cyclase and raises cGMP, relaxing smooth muscle and allowing blood inflow. PDE5 breaks down cGMP; sildenafil inhibits it, amplifying and prolonging the response. It has no effect without sexual stimulation.

PDE5 is also abundant in pulmonary vascular smooth muscle, so sildenafil dilates pulmonary arteries and reduces pulmonary vascular resistance in PAH. Weak inhibition of retinal PDE6 can cause blue-tinged vision.
uses: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO group I) in adults and children

history.title: Synthesis
history.detail: Pfizer chemists in Sandwich synthesise UK-92,480 as a potential antianginal.

history.title: Unexpected effect
history.detail: Early volunteer studies note penile erections; development shifts to erectile dysfunction.

history.title: Viagra approved
history.detail: FDA approves Viagra in March, the first oral treatment for erectile dysfunction.

history.title: PAH
history.detail: FDA approves Revatio for pulmonary arterial hypertension.

history.title: European generics
history.detail: Generic sildenafil launches in Europe after patent expiry.

history.title: US generics
history.detail: Generic sildenafil for ED becomes available in the US in December.

history.title: UK pharmacy sale
history.detail: Viagra Connect becomes available without prescription from UK pharmacies.

pk.metabolism: Hepatic CYP3A4 (major) and CYP2C9 to active N-desmethyl metabolite

serious: Severe hypotension with nitrates or riociguat (contraindicated)
Cardiovascular events in men with heart disease

facts: Sildenafil was originally investigated as a treatment for angina.
Pfizer marketed sildenafil under different brand names and doses for erectile dysfunction (Viagra) and PAH (Revatio).
